_comment: API list prices per model, USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch) tier, as listed on the provider's own pricing page on the 'checked' date. Used only to estimate cost for harnesses that don't report one; estimates are always labeled as such (docs/SITE-DATA.md, CostInfo). Not part of the registry version hash. Leave a model out when its official page doesn't list it. 'long_context' holds the higher prices a request pays when its prompt is over 'above' tokens, where the provider lists them; a model without it has one price at every size.

prices.note: cache_write is the 5-minute write ($20 for 1 hour). Full 1M context at the same rate (no long-context tier).
cache_write is the 5-minute write ($8 for 1 hour). Full 1M context at the same rate (no long-context tier). Fast mode costs more ($8 / $40).
cache_write is the 5-minute write ($4 for 1 hour). Full 1M context at the same rate (no long-context tier).
cache_write is the 5-minute write ($0.20 for 1 hour; $1 over 100,000). Prompt length counts cache reads and writes; a request over 100,000 tokens pays the higher prices on all of it.

Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write. Long context is '>272K input tokens'; the page doesn't say whether cached input counts or the whole request pays it (assumed: both, as on the other providers).

Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write. Long context is '>272K input tokens'; the page doesn't say whether cached input counts or the whole request pays it (assumed: both, as on the other providers).

Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write ($5 for 12 hours). Long context is '>272K input tokens' (pricing page); the model pages say the full request pays the higher prices.

Promotional price 'at least through November 21, 2026' (changelog, Aug 21, 2026); no end date set, regular price not listed. Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write. Long context is '>272K input tokens'; the full request pays it.

Price since the Jul 30, 2026 cut ('GPT-5.6 Terra costs 20% less'; the earlier price isn't listed). Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write. Long context is '>272K input tokens' (pricing page); the model pages say the full request pays the higher prices.

Price since the Jul 30, 2026 cut ('GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less'; the earlier price isn't listed). Standard tier; cache_write is the 30-minute write. Long context is '>272K input tokens' (pricing page); the model pages say the full request pays the higher prices.

Standard tier. No cache-write price is listed ('-'), so writes are estimated at the input price. Long context is '>272K input tokens' (pricing page); the model pages say the full request pays the higher prices.
Launch price through Nov 30, 2026; one price at every prompt size. Cache storage is billed per hour, not per written token.
Listed price from Dec 1, 2026; one price at every prompt size.
Launch price through Dec 31, 2026; one price at every prompt size. Cache storage is billed per hour.
Listed price from Jan 1, 2027; one price at every prompt size.
Long context is 'prompts > 200k tokens'. Cache storage is billed per hour ($4.50 per 1M tokens per hour).

Long context: the pricing table bills a request whose prompt reaches 200k tokens at the higher rate for all its tokens (the model page says 'exceed'). No cache-write price. Grok 4.7 Fast (Cursor, Grok Build only) costs more ($4 / $12, $6 / $18 long).
Long context: a request whose prompt reaches 200k tokens pays the higher rate on all its tokens. No cache-write price.
Long context: a request whose prompt reaches 200k tokens pays the higher rate on all its tokens. No cache-write price.
'from' is the day the price was read: no official page gives the release date. cache_write is the 5-minute write ($6 for 1 hour). No tiering by context length (quickstart).
Cached-input storage is 'Limited-time Free'; no cache-write price. One price at every prompt size.
Cached-input storage is 'Limited-time Free'; no cache-write price. One price at every prompt size. OpenCode Zen's glm-5.3-flash-free variant costs nothing while it lasts.

Peak price (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday); every other hour is off-peak at half these rates, so estimates are high for most play. No long-context tier. OpenCode Zen's deepseek-v4.1-flash-free variant costs nothing while it lasts.
Cursor's published rate (its own model, only in Cursor). The Fast variant costs $3 / $15.
Standard mode. 'No long-context premium' (1,048,576-token context). No cache-write price.
Standard mode (Contributor mode, a separate id, is cheaper). 'No long-context premium'. No cache-write price.
